QuestInfo.name: Dark Destroyer
QuestInfo.0: You can talk to Doom's soul once you obtain his relic.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate 300 monsters around your level to clear Doom of his darkness and receive his mantle.
QuestInfo.2: You received Doom's mantle after clearing the darkness from his soul.

0.0: You found my mantle! I am Doom, the scourge of darkness in a dark world.
0.1: Punish the darkness in my place. My dark soul is bound to this dark... place.
0.2: Hunt 300 monsters around your level and I will release the dark powers of my mantle to help you in your quest against darkness.

yes.0: You will be remembered as the destroyer of darkness, should you succeed.
